key_or_source: doNotLocalizeFields is declarative only (not enforced by validator)
issue: localePolicy.uiSurfaceMap[locale].doNotLocalizeFields lists: `id, key, tags, sourceRefs, behaviorHint, evidence.name`. The validator does not actively enforce that these fields stay KO-only — it walks all strings indiscriminately and only checks for forbidden lexemes / brand. If a translator localizes the `id` field by mistake, the validator catches it only if Solomon-related literal sneaks in.
recommendation: Add validator step: when walking sidecar overlay JSON, error if a field path matches doNotLocalizeFields AND its value differs from base (or simply: error if any of those fields is non-empty in sidecar). Defer to Tier B — schema enforcement complements lexeme guard.

key_or_source: JA brand pattern doesn't catch non-locked Solomon-based JA forms
issue: `/ソロモン法廷/` only catches the rejected credit subtitle. Other Solomon-based JA forms (e.g. `ソロモンの裁判`, `ソロモン裁判官`, `ソロモン王`) would slip through. Brand rule allows JA Solomon-based generally, but only `ソロモンのジレンマ` is the LOCKED title — other forms are unsanctioned.
recommendation: Optional hardening: extend JA pattern to catch additional forms outside the locked `ソロモンのジレンマ` whitelist. Tier A draft state — not blocking.

issue: Pattern `/\\bSolomon(?:'s)?(?:\\s+Dilemma)?\\b/i` matches any `Solomon` word — including potential case-content uses (witness names, biblical references, geographic Solomon Islands). False positive risk if case content ever needs to use the proper noun.
recommendation: Acceptable in current scope (active 3 cases do not reference Solomon as a non-brand term). If future case content needs the noun, add case-specific allowlist or scope the regex.

key_or_source: paraphrase vs forbidden — same blocking severity
issue: validateCaseLexemes treats both lists as equally blocking (both raise addError). Distinction is only in the error message (`truth lexeme` vs `truth paraphrase`).
recommendation: Acceptable design. Documented split lets reviewers triage by error category. No change needed.
